doc.title: Leslie Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007

title: Closing: community must be proactive
summary: Rowe thanks Johnson; she says the traditional jazz community must submit proposals and younger people must take responsibility.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well people try, if they’re really into it, they try hard and they figure out how to get what their passion is. Well it’s been a pleasure talking to you. I appreciate that you did that clinic this morning. And I hope they can figure out a way to make some headway.

I do think that the traditional jazz community does need to be more proactive and submit the proposals and learn how to do it. The trick is, as I mentioned at the panel this morning, that the older generation doesn’t want to bother with it because they’re cutting out the festivals or they’re kind of retiring from the scene, so it’s going to have to be younger people. And the key is trying to convince the younger people to take that responsibility. And I don’t know if that’s going to happen.
Okay. Well thanks for your time.
